claim: The macOS ZIP package can be extracted into the user's Applications directory, launched there, replaced in place without deleting user data, and removed while leaving that data intact.

jobs: macOS native build and bridge smoke
verification.detail: The hosted job passed Verify macOS ZIP install, replacement, and removal using python3 scripts/test_desktop_archive_install.py apps/or_app/build/macos/Build/Products/Debug/or_app.app. The helper created and extracted the ZIP, installed under ~/Applications, launched with build-only environment overrides removed, replaced the app from a fresh extraction, and verified user-data preservation and app removal.

limitations: This tests the ZIP's manual per-user placement and replacement path with the same build payload; it does not establish an OS-native installer or version-differential updater.
The launch smoke check establishes the installed app remains alive for its timeout, not interactive usability or performance.
Signing, notarization, and production release readiness are not established.
